workload_summary: Primary: in-app conversational support (chat) and document search/reranking for knowledge base. Expected steady-state 120 reqs/sec for chat during peak, spiky bursts to 350 reqs/sec for campaigns. Target p50 token latency <150ms for chat; cost sensitive on per-token. Want to validate quantized model variants for cost drop without quality drop.
poc_details: Dedicated POC: 2-week. Canary config: 10% traffic to Dedicated q4_0 variant, 90% on Hosted primary. Metrics gating: latency p50/p95, error rate, quality A/B on 1000 prompt test set. Rollback: immediate traffic switch to Hosted API variant + alerting. Region failover: us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 secondary with DNS-based routing and healthchecks. SE will document failover runbook.
technical_requirements: VPC peering, private endpoints, AWS KMS integration, SAML for admin console, audit logs export to SIEM, retention 1y. Need kernel-level perf benchmarks for long-context reranking (up to 8k tokens).
canary_and_fallback_plan: - Canary: 10% traffic for 48h, monitor quality/regressions. - Ramp to 50% if no regressions for 48h. - Fallback: two-level fallback: Dedicated -> Hosted EU variant -> Hosted NA default. - Rollback: automated traffic reroute + rollback ticket created in Jira (INF-4382).
decision_criteria: Accept POC if: (1) no quality regression per golden prompts (A/B within 1% metric), (2) latency targets met p50 <150ms and p95 <400ms at canary load, (3) cost delta >=20% using q4 variants, (4) infra and legal sign-off on residency.
legal_and_procurement_notes: Legal asked for Data Processing Addendum with EU residency clause; security to review SOC2 + ISO statements. Procurement wants a 3-month trial T&C and an option to convert to 12-month reserved capacity. Budget owner: VP Product (J. Martinez).
